family: M0 (one Holm family: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, X)

common.inner_rule: uses draws with index < t only
common.set_score: for number-level models: sum over the six numbers of log(p_i/(1-p_i)); normalised over all 2,760,681 combinations for the exact log-score

M0-A.name: dynamic Bayesian frequency
M0-A.state: alpha_i <- lam*alpha_i + x_i, beta_i <- lam*beta_i + (1-x_i), prior alpha0 = a0*6/38, beta0 = a0*32/38; p_i = alpha_i/(alpha_i+beta_i)
M0-A.inner: argmin mean Bernoulli log loss, one-step-ahead (prequential) over prior draws index 20..t-1

M0-B.name: gap hazard
M0-B.estimate: pooled over numbers: hazard_b = (hits_b + k*6/38)/(trials_b + k) from prior draws
M0-B.inner: prequential log loss over prior draws index 20..t-1

M0-C.name: draw-to-draw transition
M0-C.fit: pooled ridge logistic on per-number rows from prior draws (target rows index 2..t-1)
M0-C.inner: time split: fit on first 70% of prior rows, validate log loss on last 30%

M0-D.name: co-occurrence graph
M0-D.pair_weight: shrunk log-lift: log((c_ij + k*E)/(E + k*E)) with decayed counts (half-life h draws), E = expected co-occurrence
M0-D.number_score: z(mean pair weight to numbers of t-1) + z(decayed weighted degree)
M0-D.to_probability: p = 6/38 * exp(s*z)/mean, s fitted by inner prequential log loss over grid {0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2}
M0-D.inner: prequential log loss over prior draws index 30..t-1 (subsampled every 2nd)

M0-E.name: latent regime HMM
M0-E.emission: independent Bernoulli over 38 numbers per state (Beta(1,1) smoothing)
M0-E.inner: K by BIC on prior data
M0-E.predictive: p_i = sum_k P(state_t=k | draws < t) theta_ki

M0-F.name: supervised next-draw
features: pair support with t-1 (raw co-occurrence lift mean)
M0-F.fit: ridge logistic, features standardised on training rows only

M0-G.name: complete-set energy
M0-G.energy: E(S) = sum_i A_logodds_i + gamma * sum_{i<j in S} PMI_ij, PMI shrunk: log((c_ij+k)/(E_ij+k)), k = 5
M0-G.inner: max mean exact-set log-score on the last <=30 prior targets, partition function estimated with a fixed 20,000-combination uniform sample

M0-H.name: ensemble
M0-H.combination: logodds_H = logit(6/38) + sum_m w_m (logodds_m - logit(6/38)), m in A..F
M0-H.weights: w_m proportional to max(0, mean prior-target set log-score gain of m), normalised to sum 1; all-zero or <20 prior targets -> uniform (null)

M0-X.name: transformation search
library: r01..r10 offsets k in {-5,-4,-3,-2,-1,1,2,3,4,5} applied to t-1 with wrap 1..38
r15 sorted-position mean of t-1,t-2 (rounded half up)
r16 sorted-position t-1 + causal median positional delta
r17 sorted gap vector of t-1 re-anchored at min of t-2
M0-X.collision_rule: duplicates or out-of-range values move to the nearest unused number (upward first, wrap)
M0-X.selection: rule with highest mean overlap over all prior targets (ties: lower rule id); r00 before 20 prior targets
M0-X.set_score: overlap with rule output (desc), then L1 distance between sorted vectors (asc)

M0-R.name: null controls (not in family)
controls: R1 uniform exact ranking (rank drawn uniformly, seed 20261008+t)
R2 random number scores (U(0,1) per number, seed 20261009+t) as additive set scores
R3 random rule from the X library each target (seed 20261010+t)
R4 misaligned permutation null: each model's scores at t evaluated against the realised draws of other targets (1,000 permutations of target labels, seed 20261011)
